messages:
alyssa (PM): heads-up — thinking through the UX for automatic fallback when model-side errors spike. want to align on telemetry signals, operator triage flow, and what we show in the console
max (Eng): SGTM. what's the primary signal? 5xx from model? request timeout? malformed responses?
alyssa (PM): good q. proposal: multi-signal trigger — sustained 5xx rate over 5m OR p95 latency > 1.5s with error rate bump. also a model-validation failure signal from the runtime (bad logits)
jorge (SRE): prefer threshold combos rather than single signal. 5xx alone can be noisy during infra blips. need hystereses and cooldowns.
maya (Design): from UX side, operators want a clear reason string + quick links: "open recent errors", "rollout compare", "replay requests". avoid overloading with raw metrics.
sam (Infra): we should include the effective routing change in the audit entry. like: "switched route A->B (fallback) due to p95 latency 1.8s over 6m)". that helps debugging.
alyssa (PM): agreed. thinking the console shows a collapsed card: summary line, cause tag, impacted routes, and an expand for traces + sample requests
max (Eng): implementation note: the runtime emits an event when it flips fallback. it contains: model_from, model_to, trigger_type, window_stats. we can enrich that on the control plane with more context
maya (Design): can we show a small sparkline + a short clip of sample failed response? maybe first 3 failing examples redacted.
jorge (SRE): if we surface samples, must auto-redact PII. add sampling rules: one failure per minute per route, scrub fields.
max (Eng): audit-bot: created event log schema v2 for autofallback (id: afb-evt-v2)
audit-bot: {"event":"afb-evt-v2.created","id":"afb-20230425-001","schema":"v2"}
alyssa (PM): nice. UI question — should auto-fallbacks create an incident (pager) when impact > X? or just create an audit + notif?
jorge (SRE): pager only when customer error budget cross or when fallback persists > 15m for high-tier customers. otherwise a slack notif to #eng-platform and console banner
maya (Design): for the console banner copy: "Automatic fallback engaged — touch to inspect. Cause: high latency (p95)". affordances: "Unwind" (if operator wants to force revert) + "Open replay"
sam (Infra): need an operator-safe escape hatch in API: POST /rollouts/{id}/override with reason + dry_run flag. that should append an audit entry and optionally do a dry revert
max (Eng): logging detail: include rollout_revision, model_checksum, kernel_variant in the audit so we can repro exact binary path
alyssa (PM): also record the evaluated prompt set (hash) if rollout used canary prompts. helps quality debugging
jorge (SRE): telemetry: add a derived metric "fallback_rate_by_route" and keep 45d retention on traces for legal/forensics requests
maya (Design): UI mock idea: timeline view with markers: trigger -> rollout start -> samples -> operator actions. quick filter by "root cause: latency|error|validation"
max (Eng): one API debate: should the control plane auto-create a fallback rollout or just flip routing and create a readonly audit rollout? pros/cons?
alyssa (PM): prefer readonly audit rollout + a suggested rollback patch for operator to review. avoids opaque automatic commits.
sam (Infra): ops automation can accept the suggested patch if a customer has auto-accept enabled (enterprise feature)
jorge (SRE): we also need to limit oscillation: require minimum stable window 2m before switching back. avoid flip-flop if signal wobbles
maya (Design): for the inspection panel, add a small timeline showing signal history and an "explain" link to show which rule fired with the raw numbers
max (Eng): implementation sketch:
```
// event emitted by runtime
{ "type":"autofallback","route":"/v1/generate","from":"m-xl","to":"m-small","trigger":"p95_latency","window_sec":300,"p95":1.82,"5xx_pct":2.1 }
```
control plane merges with route config + customer tier -> creates audit-rollout object (read-only)
alyssa (PM): ok action items: max to spec event enrichment for v2, jorge to write SRE runbook thresholds + pager rules, maya to mock the inspection panel, sam to add API override endpoint stub
max (Eng): will do. I'll drop a gdoc with event schema and example queries
jorge (SRE): I'll sketch pagers and downtime thresholds — will post to #eng-oncall for feedback
maya (Design): mockups coming by EOD Wednesday
sam (Infra): I'll add API prototype to infra repo and open a PR for the override endpoint
alyssa (PM): thanks team. flagging for product review next week. if anyone sees an edge case not covered call it out here
max (Eng): one edge: model validation spikes might be correlated with input distribution drift. consider hooking in the eval pipeline to compare recent prompts to baseline
jorge (SRE): noted. also add a rate cap on autofallback generation so we don't flood audit logs during noisy events
alyssa (PM): perfect. closing loop — I'll update the RFC with these bits and tag reviewers
maya (Design): :thumbsup:
max (Eng): :+1:
jorge (SRE): ack
sam (Infra): ack
